name: PCI-DSS Cardholder Data Policy
text: Cardholder data must never be stored, logged or cached on the client. Payment fields must be tokenized on submit. Any change to checkout requires security review.

name: DOT Fare Advertising & Consumer Rule
text: Advertised and displayed fares must include all mandatory taxes and carrier-imposed fees up front. A customer must explicitly consent before any fare is purchased or changed. Refunds are owed automatically for significant changes and cancellations.

name: ACAA Accessibility Standard
text: Customer-facing web and app pages must meet WCAG 2.1 AA, including accessible names for every control and a logical focus order.

name: Security & Access Policy
text: Every change handed off to engineering needs a security review of the systems it reads from and writes to.
